CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-54724  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Budget Oversight Committee
  meeting of Tuesday, August 27, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-54725  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Grow Long Beach,
